enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Adamantine: Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.

Smiting: On Hit: 4 to 24 Bane damage to Constructs.On Vorpal Hit: If a construct struck by this weapon has fewer than 1000 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the construct has above 1000 Hit Points, it takes 100 damage.
